entry_state: The contents finish with financing/group, bank, insurance, implementation and acceptance chapters, then operation reference, grammar and research appendices. The reader reaches Part I after twenty-two contents pages, with no concise orientation to analyst, researcher or implementer paths.
exit_state: The reader can derive the fixed/floating interest family and its joint cash dependence, distinguish journals from contracts and report compatibility from identification, and understand why persistent uncertainty need not be a tree. Reconstruction now has a context-sensitive observation relation, a signed stock-flow bridge and a joint constrained history family. Timing overlaps and cross-classified exposure remain to be explained.

observations.finding: The rate example states principal, historical payments, shock duration and missing hedges before its equations. Its interest bounds and narrowed family are arithmetically correct. However closing cash C=95-I also needs absence of receipts or other cash changes; saying interest is the only cash payment does not exclude cash receipts.
observations.disposition: confirmed assumption omission; change to sole cash movement in next protected successor

observations.finding: Journals, contractual histories, report compatibility, query-dependent equivalence, incomplete model scope and persistent versus fresh uncertainty are distinguished using concrete counterexamples. The source paragraphs explicitly avoid transferring inverse-problem or identification theorems wholesale. Their external technical claims have not been independently reread in this segment.
observations.disposition: retain argument; source verification remains in the separate source ledger

observations.finding: The phrase progressively stronger requirements risks suggesting that agreement under an arbitrary single query logically entails report agreement. The intended order only applies after restricting to histories compatible with the same evidence.
observations.disposition: clarify the common admitted-family premise when making the small chapter repair

observations.finding: Rounding is explicitly conditional on a declared endpoint convention. Stock-flow and gross/net receivable equations name their scopes and do not turn unspecified movements into zero. Joint-family infeasibility is correctly separated from evidence of issuer misconduct.
observations.disposition: retain; rounding illustration must remain distinct from the actual issuer rounding-policy question
